summary: Keep bounded conversation admission on the existing incremental owner inventory

replay.detail: No additional replay or recovery work is introduced. Admission reads the existing runtime identity inventory at the requested store snapshot.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, or schema versions change. This corrects the exact-history and roster-lookup wording in ws-conversation-admission-no-schema.json: agent resolution and ownership reuse the incremental runtime identity inventory, with direct lookup for a known subject and hash validation.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests, or coordinated member upgrade requirements change.

compatibility.detail: Existing collection and conversation wire formats and authorization remain unchanged. The existing sixteen-subscription socket limit is preserved, independently of the eight per-socket and thirty-two process-wide physical admission limits.

downtime.detail: No additional installation interruption is required beyond the ordinary binary restart; restart duration has not been measured for this change.

manual.detail: No manual migration or configuration change is required, and stored identities and conversation state are preserved.

recovery.detail: No database or rules migration is added, so this change adds no new restriction on binary swap-back.
